spans.s:
धूम, अस्, m. (connected by some with rt. 1. ध्मा),
smoke, vapour, incense; mist, haze; breath (Ved.); a
cloud; (in medic.) smoke as a sternutatory in five
forms; = गो-धूम, = शिलारस, a kind of incense; a
place prepared for the building of a house; N. of a
man; (आ), f. a kind of plant (= धीरावी); [cf. गो-ध्˚,
चरिष्णु-ध्˚, तृष्ट-ध्˚: cf. also rt. 1. ध्मा; Gr.
θῡ-μό-ς; Lat. fū-mu-s; Old Germ. daum, toum,
‘fume;’ Lith. dū-mai, ‘smoke;’ Slav. dü-mŭ,
‘smoke;’ Hib. dluimh, ‘cloud, darkness.’]
—धू-
म-केतन, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smoke-marked,’ whose ensign
or mark is smoke; (अस्), m. fire or its deity; a
meteor, a comet; Ketu or the personified descending
node.
—धूम-केतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. ‘whose sign
is smoke,’ known or to be known from smoke;
(उस्), m. fire; a comet or falling star, the personi-
fied descending node; N. of a son of Kṛśāśva by
Arcis; of Tṛṇa-vindu by Alambuṣā.
—धूम-
गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. smelling of smoke.
—धूम-
गन्धिक, अम्, n. a kind of grass (= रोहिष-
तृण).
—धूम-जाङ्गज (धूम-ज-अङ्˚), अम्,
n. ammoniac.
—धूम-जाल, अम्, n. a multitude or
mass of clouds or smoke.
—धूम-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, Ved. seeing smoke or vapour (as a person affected
with a peculiar disease of the eye).
—धूम-ध्वज,
अस्, m. ‘whose banner or symbol is smoke,’ fire.
—धूम-प, अस्, आ, अम्, drinking or inhaling
only smoke; [cf. धूम-प्राश.]
—धूम-प-
थ, अस्, m. ‘the way of smoke,’ sacrifice; seeking
salvation by works; [cf. धूम-वर्त्मन्.]
—धू-
म-पान, अम्, n. inhaling smoke or vapour; smoking
tobacco.
—धूमपान-विधि, इस्, m. ‘the rule of
inhaling smoke,’ N. of the twenty-eighth chapter of
the Śārṅgadhara-saṃhitā.
—धूम-प्रभा, f., N.
of one of the seventeen divisions of hell where smoke
[]
takes the place of light.
—धूम-प्राश, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘smoke-eating,’ feeding only on smoke, as a hermit;
[cf. धूम-प.]
—धूम-मङ्गज, various reading
for धूम-जाङ्गज, q. v.
—धूम-मय, अस्, ई,
अम्, consisting of smoke or vapour, smoky.
—धू-
म-महिषी, f. fog, mist.
—धूम-योनि, इस्, m.
‘engendered from smoke or vapour,’ a cloud.
—धू-
म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, smoky; smoking, steaming;
containing the word धूम.
—धूमवत्-त्व, अम्,
n. smokiness.
—धूम-वर्चस्, आस्, m., N. of a
man.
—धूम-वर्ण, अस्, m. ‘smoke-coloured,’ N.
of a king of the serpents.
—धूम-वर्त्मन्, अ,
n. ‘the path of smoke,’ sacrifice; seeking salvation
by works.
—धूम-शिख, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smoke-
crested’ (said of flame or a tongue of fire).
—धूम-
संहति, इस्, f. a quantity of smoke, a mass or cloud
of smoke.
—धूमाकार (˚म-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having the form or appearance of smoke.
—धू-
माक्ष (˚म-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. having dim,
dark or troubled (?) eyes.
—धूमाङ्ग (˚म-अङ्˚)
= शिंशपा.
—धूमाभ (˚म-आभ), अस्, आ, अम्,
of a smoky appearance or colour, of a purple colour;
(अस्), m. purple.
—धूमा-वती, f., N. of a place of
pilgrimage.
—धूमावती-मन्त्र, अस्, m. or धू-
मावती-मनु, उस्, m., N. of certain magical for-
mulas.
—धूमावलि (˚म-आव्˚), इस्, f. a wreath or
cloud of smoke.
—धूमोत्थ (˚म-उत्˚), अम्, n.
= वज्र-क्षार, ammoniac; [cf. धूम-जाङ्गज.]
—धूमोद्गार (˚म-उद्˚), अस्, m. ‘the issuing of
smoke or vapour,’ N. of a kind of disease.
—धू-
मोपहत (˚म-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘smoke-struck,’
suffocated with smoke.
—धूमोर्णा (˚म-ऊर्˚), f.,
N. of the wife of Yama; of the wife of Mārkaṇ-
ḍeya; [cf. धूम्रोर्णा.]
—धूमोर्णा-पति, इस्, m.
‘husband of Dhūmorṇā,’ epithet of Yama, ruler of
the dead.
धूम धूम, धूम्र. See p. 457, cols. 2, 3.

धूमक, अस्, आ, अम्, = धूम at the end of
a comp.; (इका), f. smoke, vapour, fog.
—धू-
मक-पुष्पा, f. a species of plant (compared to
smoke).

धूमय (fr. धूम), Nom. P. धूमयति,
&c., to cover with smoke, obscure with mist: Pass.
धूम्यते, &c., to be obscured with vapour or mist;
to be about to be eclipsed, to be darkened; [cf.
धूमाय.]

धूमाय (fr. धूम), Nom. P. A. धूमायति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to smoke, be covered or obscured with
smoke, to steam: Caus. P. धूमाययति, -यितुम्,
to cause to smoke or to be covered with smoke,
mist, vapour, &c.

धूमल, अस्, आ, अम्, smoke-coloured, of a
smoky hue, brownish red, of a purple colour; (अस्),
m. a colour compounded of black and red, purple;
a kind of musical instrument.

धूमायन, अम्, n. smoking, steaming; (in
medic.) heat, fever, feverishness.
धूमायित, अम्, n. the act of smoking.

धूमित, अस्, आ, अम्, obscured with smoke, mist,
&c., darkened; (आ), f., scil. दिश्, that quarter towards
which the sun turns first.

धूमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, smoking, steaming; (इनी), f.,
N. of one of the seven tongues of Agni; of the
wife of Aja-mīḍha; of another woman.

धूम्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being obscured with
mist &c., being obscured.

धूम्या, f. thick smoke, a volume or cloud of
smoke.
—धूम्याट (˚या-अट), अस्, m. the fork-
tailed shrike.

धूम्र, अस्, आ, अम्, smoky, smoke-coloured,
grey; (according to the lexicographers) dark-red or
the colour of fire seen through smoke; of a deep
purple colour, purple; (metaphorically) dark, lurid,
obscured; (अस्), m. a mixture of red and black;
purple (the colour); incense. (= तुरुष्क); N. of
one of Skanda's attendants; of a Dānava; of a Muni;
of a monkey or bear [cf. धूम्रायण and धौ-
म्रायण]; an epithet of Śiva; of Parāśara; (in
[]
astrology) N. of the twenty-eighth Yoga; (आ), f. a
kind of gourd (= शशाण्डुली); epithet of Durgā; of
the mother of Vasu-dhara; (अम्), n. sin, vice,
wickedness; [cf. ताम्र-ध्˚.]
—धूम्र-केतु, उस्,
m. ‘grey-bannered,’ N. of a son of Bharata; of
Tṛṇa-vindu.
—धूम्र-केश, अस्, m. ‘dark-haired,’
N. of a son of Pṛthu and Arcis; of a son of
Kṛśāśva and Arcis [cf. धूम-केतु]; of a son of
Danu.
—धूम्र-गिरि, इस्, m. ‘the smoky moun-
tain,’ N. of a mountain.
—धूम्र-धी, ईस्, ईस्,
इ, ‘whose intellect is dim’ or ‘whose devotion is
obscured,’ devoted to works.
—धूम्र-नीकाश, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. of a deep dark-red colour.
—धूम्र-
पत्त्रा, f. ‘having grey or dark-red leaves,’ N. of a
shrub (= धूम्राह्वा, सु-लभा, स्वयम्-भुवा,
गृध्र-पत्त्रा, गृध्राणी, कृमि-घ्नी, श्रीम-
लापहा).
—धूम्र-मूलिका, f. ‘having a grey or
dark-red root,’ a kind of grass (= शूली).
—धूम्र-
रुच्, क्, क्, क्, of a purple hue, of a deep-red colour.
—धूम्र-रोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. dark-red, deep
purple.
—धूम्र-लोचन, अस्, m. ‘dark-eyed,’ a
pigeon; N. of a general of the Asura Śumbha.
—धूम्र-लोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, dark-red, deep purple.
—धूम्र-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, smoky-coloured,
dark-red, deep purple; (अस्), m. incense; N. of a
son of Aja-mīḍha and Dhūminī; N. of a mountain;
(आ), f., N. of one of the seven tongues of Fire;
flame.
—धूम्र-वर्णक, अस्, m. ‘the dark-
coloured one,’ a kind of animal living in caves, a
fox; [cf. कोकड.]
—धूम्रवर्णा-मनु, N. of
a magical formula.
—धूम्र-शूक, अस्, m. ‘having
grey bristles,’ a camel; (also read धूम्र-शूल.)
—धूम्र-संरक्त-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, having
dark-red or greyish-red eyes.
—धूम्राक्ष (˚र-
अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, grey-eyed; (अस्), m., N. of a Ra-
kṣas; of a son of Hema-candra, grandson of Tṛṇa-
vindu [cf. धूम्राश्व]; of a king of the Niṣadhas.
—धूम्राक्षि (˚र-अक्˚), इस्, m. a pearl of a bad
colour.
—धूम्राट (˚र-अट), अस्, m. the fork-
tailed shrike; [cf. धूम्याट.]
—धूम्रानीक (˚र-
अन्˚), अस्, m., N. of one of the seven sons of Medhā-
tithi and a Varṣa called after him.
—धूम्राभ-
(˚र-आभ), अस्, m. air, wind, atmosphere (some-
times of a smoky or dark-red hue?).
—धूम्राश्व
(˚र-अस्˚), अस्, m. ‘having dark horses,’ N. of a son
of Su-candra (son of Hema-candra) and father of
Sṛñjaya; [cf. धूम्राक्ष.]
—धूम्राह्वा (˚र-
आह्˚), f. = धूम्र-पत्त्रा.
—धूम्रोर्णा (˚र-ऊर्˚),
f. = धूमोर्णा (?).

धूम्रक, अस्, m. ‘the grey animal,’ a camel;
(इका), f. the plant Dalbergia Sissoo (= शिंशपा).

धूम्रायण, अस्, m. (fr. धूम्र), a patronymic
from Dhūmra; [cf. धौम्रायण.]

धूम्रिमन्, आ, m., Ved. dark-red (the colour),
darkness of colour; obscurity.
